verdict.rationale: Jitsu is a SaaS data pipeline that handles customer event data, so a no-AI-training commitment or opt-out is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack has no AI-training policy, opt-out control, or contractual no-training commitment. Self-hosting, encryption, SOC 2 and the existence of a DPA are adjacent privacy features, not evidence for this story, so they earn no credit.
